2.3.2 Disease Specific Knowledge Acquired
Through the daily practice, the interaction with collaborators, reading documents in the library
and online literature review , I have developed and consolidated knowledge on the:
-­‐ Overall architecture and detailed elements of a clinical development plan and of
clinical trial preparation and implementation.
-­‐ Design of clinical trial on infectious diseases,
-­‐ Epidemiology and immunology of Cholera,
-­‐ Epidemiology and immunology of Typhoid Fever,
-­‐ Epidemiology and immunology of Dengue Fever.

2.3.3 Integration/Contribution in the Team

In order to apply my theoretical knowledge, to develop and consolidate practical skills in
clinical trial, I was involved and I have contributed to different activities of Clinical Trials and
Regulatory Department of IVI.

More specifically, I was part of the clinical team of a Cholera Vaccine Trial, sponsored by IVI
and conducted at the International Centre for Diarrheal Diseases Research in Bangladesh
(ICDDR, B) in Dhaka, Bangladesh. I am also part of clinical team of a Typhoid Conjugate
Vaccine manufactured by SK Chemicals, Republic of Korea, and tested in the Philippines.

The different activities in the framework of this clinical trial are:
• Participation to the project team meetings to understand the management of
the research project and regulatory pathway.
• Development of protocol and related trial documents
• Visit of Incepta Pharmaceuticals in Bangladesh, manufacturer of the cholera
vaccine (Cholvax): visit of the plant, general overview on the vaccine
production process and discussion of the licensure strategy.

• Contribution to the trial monitoring activities (Pre–trial Monitoring Visit, Interim
Monitoring Visits…) .
• I chaired the Safety Monitoring Committee of a Typhoid Conjugate Vaccine
Phase I Trial sponsored by IVI and conducted at the Research Institute of
Tropical Medicine (RITM) in Manila, The Philippines. I contributed to the
development of the synopsis of typhoid conjugate vaccine Phase II and Phase
III clinical trials.
• Design and the maintenance of the Trial Master File.
• Contribution to the prioritization of the development of clinical operations
SOPs

Moreover, I am working with my supervisor (Dr Jean-Louis Excler) to the development of a
manuscript on the dynamics of vaccine administration (injectable or oral) per age groups and
future projections. With the Policy and Economic Research team of IVI, we also developed a
protocol for the systematic review on the cholera outbreaks the review is ongoing.
